7.4.3.3.2.2 Com High Proxy
[SWS_SwCluC_02607] Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com High Proxy shall provide the symbolic name values for the ComSignals, for Com users in the Application Software Cluster.⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_02608] Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com High Proxy shall provide the symbolic name values for the ComSignalGroups resp. ComGroupSignals, for Com users in the Application Software Cluster.⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_02609] Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211, SRS_SwCluC_00202
⌈The Com High Proxy shall provide the functions for transmission requests of ComSignals and ComSignalGroups
• Com_SendSignal module
• Com_SendDynSignal
• Com_SendSignalGroup
• Com_SendSignalGroupArray
• Com_SendSignalWithMetaData
• Com_SendDynSignalWithMetaData
• Com_SendSignalGroupWithMetaData
• Com_SendSignalGroupArrayWithMetaData required by the Com users in the Application Software Cluster.
⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_02665] Serialization in Com_SendSignalGroup Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211, SRS_SwCluC_00202
⌈The function Com_SendSignalGroup provided by the Com High Proxy shall
• perform a transformation from the original data passed from the RTE in Application Software Cluster to the uint8 array, AND
• invoke the Com_SendSignalGroupArray API to send the data as uint8 array representation.
⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_02666] Serialization in Com_SendSignalGroupWithMetaData Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211, SRS_SwCluC_00202
⌈The function Com_SendSignalGroupWithMetaData provided by the Com High Proxy shall
• perform a transformation from the original data passed from the RTE in Application Software Cluster to the uint8 array, AND
• invoke the Com_SendSignalGroupArrayWithMetaData API to send the data as uint8 array representation.
⌋
